reviews.checked_passages: Text inspection of the five function classes and dummy-variable convention pp.463–465; theorem p.466; full selected proof through Lemmas1–8 and Theorems1–2 pp.466–475. PDF text/OCR inspected; no visual layout review.

reviews.outcome: Elementary proof supports a new functional-completeness entry without the full clone lattice. Essential adaptation: the five-class criterion characterizes all positive-arity truth functions. The corpus also includes arity zero, so full completeness additionally requires a genuine nullary symbol or closed term. A unary term having constant value is not a closed term. Once one closed term and positive-arity completeness exist, derived negation supplies the other closed constant. Use XOR-affine terminology with an explicit bridge to the source’s counting functions; no external linear algebra is required.
